_comment: Tier-2 for kratos structural_dynamics / linear_elasticity: resolves a contradiction BETWEEN two catalog entries about POINT_LOAD. On Kratos 10.4.0 StructuralMechanicsApplication has no AssignVectorByDirectionProcess attribute (so linear_elasticity was right about that), AND the core module KratosMultiphysics.assign_vector_by_direction_process does crash on POINT_LOAD with 'Error: Trying to fix/free dof of variable POINT_LOAD_X but this dof does not exist in node #1!' (so structural_dynamics was right about that). assign_vector_variable_process sets POINT_LOAD = [0, -100, 0] cleanly. Verified by execution 2026-08-03. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 drives the by-direction probe through assign_vector_variable_process, the process that works, instead of assign_vector_by_direction_process; the fix/free-dof crash the fixture records then does not happen. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: core_by_direction_raises=True, raises_about_fix_free_dof=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/point_load_direction_process_rejects && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
